FACET_HINT: Fields: click+drag selects, double-click a word, Ctrl+A/C/X/V, arrows / Home / End. Hover a button for its tooltip.
FACET_NAV_HINT: No mouse? Arrow keys / a gamepad move the focus ring; Enter or A activates; Left/Right adjust sliders & selects.
FACET_TABLE_HINT: Click a header to sort (again flips it; another header adds a secondary key). Type filter at left; gamepad/Enter to browse rows.
FACET_TIP_TABLE: Sortable, filterable table — click headers; confirm with a pad to browse
FACET_TIP_INV: Drag to move/swap items; click without moving to select
FACET_ACC_BODY: Collapsible section — click a header to expand or collapse it.
FACET_TIP_PROGRESS: A non-interactive bar bound to the slider value
FACET_SKIN_BODY: Sprite-framed panel — corners stay crisp as it stretches.
FACET_TIP_QUESTS: A live list bound to QuestLog — gold title = ready to turn in
FACET_TIP_VK: Type with a navigable on-screen keyboard (gamepad-friendly)
FACET_TIP_REBIND: Click, then press a key to rebind (Esc cancels)
FACET_TIP_DIALOG: Open a modal dialog (Esc or click outside to dismiss)
FACET_TIP_TOAST: Push a timed toast (cycles info / success / warn / error)
FACET_TIP_SAY: Play a paged dialogue with typewriter text (Enter / Space / A or click to advance)
FACET_SAY_1: The cavern mouth yawns ahead, breathing cold air across the ledge.
FACET_SAY_2: Careful — the rope bridge looks frayed. One wrong step and it's a long way down.
FACET_SAY_3: Stay close, and keep your lantern lit. We move on my mark.
FACET_TIP_NORMAL: A standard button — hover to see this tooltip
FACET_TIP_RO: Read-only field — hover tooltips work on any widget
FACET_TIP_SELECT: Click the < > arrows to cycle options
FACET_TIP_CHECK: A box + tick toggle (click anywhere on the row)
FACET_TIP_STEPPER: Click the < > sides to step the number (0–10)
FACET_TIP_DROPDOWN: Click to drop a list of options — pick one (keyboard / gamepad navigable)
